step1_analysis.circuit_type: Programmable Bias Current Generator / Current DAC
step1_analysis.description: A 5-bit source and 5-bit sink current steering DAC used to calibrate the bias current of an IF filter. It uses binary-weighted current sources to adjust the output current at the Bias node, compensating for process variations to improve yield.

paper_reference.title: An AI-Calibrated IF Filter: A Yield Enhancement Method With Area and Power Dissipation Reductions

Power.description: Total power consumption of the calibration circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming VDD=1.8V, to achieve 39uW, the base current Iref should be approximately 21.6uA (39uW / 1.8V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matched to the paper's reported power dissipation for the calibration block.

I_base.description: Base bias current when all calibration switches are off

sky130_expected.reasoning: Sets the nominal operating point for the IF filter OTAs.

I_LSB.description: Current step size for the least significant bit (Ir)

I_max_tune.description: Maximum current that can be sourced or sunk for calibration

Filter_Frequency.description: Center frequency of the IF filter (system level)

sky130_expected.reasoning: System-level metric, cannot be measured on the DAC alone.

Filter_Gain.description: Gain of the IF filter (system level)

sky130_expected.reasoning: System-level metric, cannot be measured on the DAC alone.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the base bias current, LSB step size, maximum source/sink tuning currents, and power consumption of the calibration DAC.
step3_testbench.spice:
* AI-Calibrated IF Filter Bias DAC Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param Ir=1u

* Modified DUT for ngspice compatibility (ideal switches replaced with V-controlled switches)
Iref VDD Bias 21.6u
I2 VDD N6 {16*Ir}
I9 VDD N10 {8*Ir}
I5 VDD N11 {4*Ir}
I7 VDD N3 {2*Ir}
I8 VDD N12 {Ir}
I6 Bias N8 {16*Ir}
I11 Bias N7 {8*Ir}
I4 Bias N4 {4*Ir}
I10 Bias N5 {2*Ir}
I1 Bias N2 {Ir}

S1 N6 Bias ctrl1 0 switch_model
S2 N10 Bias ctrl2 0 switch_model
S3 N11 Bias ctrl3 0 switch_model
S4 N3 Bias ctrl4 0 switch_model
S5 N12 Bias ctrl5 0 switch_model
S6 N8 VSS ctrl6 0 switch_model
S7 N7 VSS ctrl7 0 switch_model
S8 N4 VSS ctrl8 0 switch_model
S9 N5 VSS ctrl9 0 switch_model
S10 N2 VSS ctrl10 0 switch_model

.model switch_model SW(vt=0.9 ron=1 roff=1G)

* Supplies and Bias Load
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VBias Bias 0 0.9

* Control Voltages (Digital Inputs)
Vctrl1 ctrl1 0 0
Vctrl2 ctrl2 0 0
Vctrl3 ctrl3 0 0
Vctrl4 ctrl4 0 0
Vctrl5 ctrl5 0 0
Vctrl6 ctrl6 0 0
Vctrl7 ctrl7 0 0
Vctrl8 ctrl8 0 0
Vctrl9 ctrl9 0 0
Vctrl10 ctrl10 0 0

.control
  * 1. Measure Base Current and Power (All switches OFF)
  op
  let i_base = -i(VBias)
  let pwr_base = -i(VVDD)*1.8
  
  * 2. Measure LSB Source Current (Turn on S5)
  alter Vctrl5 = 1.8
  op
  let i_lsb_src = -i(VBias) - i_base
  
  * 3. Measure Max Source Current (Turn on S1-S5)
  alter Vctrl1 = 1.8
  alter Vctrl2 = 1.8
  alter Vctrl3 = 1.8
  alter Vctrl4 = 1.8
  op
  let i_max_src = -i(VBias) - i_base
  
  * 4. Measure Max Sink Current (Turn off S1-S5, Turn on S6-S10)
  alter Vctrl1 = 0
  alter Vctrl2 = 0
  alter Vctrl3 = 0
  alter Vctrl4 = 0
  alter Vctrl5 = 0
  alter Vctrl6 = 1.8
  alter Vctrl7 = 1.8
  alter Vctrl8 = 1.8
  alter Vctrl9 = 1.8
  alter Vctrl10 = 1.8
  op
  let i_max_snk = i_base - (-i(VBias))
  
  * Print Results
  print i_base
  print i_lsb_src
  print i_max_src
  print i_max_snk
  print pwr_base
  quit
.endc
.end
